name: Spicy Tortilla Egg Roll with Avocado & Pico de Gallo Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 ½ red bell peppers
1 ½ small bunches cilantro
1 ½ limes
1 ½ avocados

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic; transfer to a large bowl.
Trim cucumbers, then halve lengthwise and slice thinly crosswise. Add to the bowl with the garlic.
Halve grape tomatoes. Seed and slice bell peppers into thin strips; transfer both to the bowl with the garlic.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Juice the limes into the bowl and season with salt and pepper. Stir to combine the salad, then set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Crack the eggs into another medium bowl and season with salt and pepper; whisk together.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 eggs
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add the oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Pour one-sixth of the egg mixture (or about ⅓ cup) into the skillet and swirl to make an omelet the size of a tortilla. Let cook, undisturbed, for 30 seconds. Before the egg fully sets, place a tortilla on top and press down gently with a spatula. When egg is cooked, after about 1 minute, flip tortilla and cook for 30 seconds more; transfer to a plate and cover with aluminum foil.
Add more oil (½ tsp per tortilla) to the skillet and repeat with remaining egg mixture and tortillas.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil
5 large flour tortillas

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, halve and pit the avocados; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon.
Lay the tortillas, egg-side-up, on a flat surface; divide the avocado, pico de gallo salad, and chili-garlic sauce between them. Roll tightly to close, then slice each roll in half.
To serve, divide rolls between plates. Enjoy!
